sections.heading: MINOR IN EPIDEMIOLOGY AND BIOSTATISTICS
lines: Faculty of Science/Schulich School of Medicine & Dentistry; including BMSc and Neuroscience - Epidemiology and Biostatistics
Completion of first-year requirements, including the following courses with a mark of at least 60% in each half course:

1.0 course from: Applied Mathematics 1201A/B, Calculus 1000A/B or Calculus 1500A/B, Calculus 1301A/B or Calculus 1501A/B, Data Science 1000A/B, Mathematics 1225A/B, Mathematics 1228A/B, Mathematics 1229A/B, Mathematics 1600A/B, Statistical Sciences 1024A/B.
0.5 course from: Biology 2244A/B or Statistical Sciences 2244A/B, with a minimum mark of 60%.
0.5 course: Epidemiology 2200A/B with a minimum mark of 60%.
1.0 course: Biostatistics 3100A with a minimum mark of 60%, Biostatistics 3110B.
1.0 course: Epidemiology 3200A with a minimum mark of 60%, Epidemiology 3210B.
1.0 additional course at the 3000-level or above in Biostatistics or Epidemiology.
